attempted_claim: Fix K = Q(sqrt(-3)), O = O_K, ell = 3 with normalized generator c of H^3(Z/3, mu_3), and the fixed meridian system closing the cusps of congruence quotients of H^3 by principal congruence subgroups Gamma(p) of PSL_2(O). Let p_1,...,p_8 be the first eight prime ideals of O ordered by norm with N(p_i) congruent to 1 mod 3 and p_i not dividing 6. For each i let M(p_i) be the closed Dehn-filled manifold so obtained and let rho_i: pi_1^{et}(Spec O_K minus S_{p_i}) -> Z/3 be the canonical S_{p_i}-ramified cyclic Kummer character of order 3 with S_{p_i} the primes dividing N(p_i) together with the primes above 3. Determine with proof, for all eight i, the exact pairs (H_1(M(p_i); Z), CS_c(rho_i) in (1/3)Z/Z). A complete answer is the full eight-entry table with homology certificates and explicit Artin-symbol cocycle evaluations; partial tables do not count.
claim_type: eight-entry homology plus mod-3 invariant census
decisive_failure: No eight-entry table is claimed because the target is underdetermined as stated: the p_8 norm tie, the unspecified Dehn-filling slopes, and the non-canonical Kummer character each admit multiple answers, and rigorous certificates at the required congruence indices are infeasible with the python-only tooling available in this session. The WORKLOG audit checks are routine verifications rather than independently valuable results.
